title: Scotland set Sri Lanka 152 to keep semi-final hopes alive
byline: Sri Lanka will need 152 runs to keep their ICC Women’s T20 World Cup semi-final hopes alive after Scotland posted a competitive 151/6 in their final Group B match in Manchester on Friday.

title: Sri Lanka edge Scotland as Athapaththu keeps semi-final hopes alive
byline: Sri Lanka kept their ICC Women’s T20 World Cup semi-final hopes alive after Chamari Athapaththu’s explosive start laid the foundation for a thrilling three-wicket victory over Scotland in their final Group 2 match at Old Trafford on Friday.

title: Senior Presidential Secretariat Official arrested over fake passport scam
byline: A Senior Assistant Secretary attached to the Parliamentary and Cabinet Division of the Presidential Secretariat was arrested for allegedly forging a passport under another individual’s name to assist an organized criminal in fleeing the country.

title: 40 injured as SLTB bus plunges into precipice near Diyatalawa
byline: At least 40 passengers sustained injuries when a Sri Lanka Transport Board (SLTB) bus veered off the road and plunged into a 20-foot precipice near the Diyatalawa railway station. The bus was en route from Colombo to Badulla when the accident occurred.

title: Jangoo puts West Indies in control
byline: West Indies moved into a strong position on Day 2 of the first Test after Amir Jangoo’s unbeaten half-century steered the hosts to 271 for 5 in reply to Sri Lanka’s first-innings total of 308 in Antigua.

title: CDS tightens dormant account rules to curb fraud risk
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange (CSE) will begin restricting transactions on dormant securities accounts from next week, under a new investor protection framework, aimed at reducing fraud risks and strengthening oversight of long-inactive holdings.

title: Authorities step up push to transform handloom sector into export growth driver
byline: The authorities are stepping up efforts to position its traditional handloom industry as a higher-value export sector, with a renewed focus on innovation, product development and branding, to capture the growing global demand for sustainable and ethically produced textiles.

title: President’s US$ 1 billion loss claim: COPF to inquire from Central Bank officials
byline: In the wake of President Anura Kumara Dissanayake’s revelation that Sri Lanka lost nearly US$ 1 billion in foreign exchange due to fraud involving the banking system, Parliament’s Committee on Public Finance (COPF) is set to question Central Bank officials next week, an official said.

title: Dembele’s 32-minute Hat-Trick writes World Cup history
byline: Ousmane Dembele makes FIFA World Cup history as the England national football team secure knockout-stage qualification, alongside other major developments from the 2026 tournament.

title: Trump threatens 100% tariff on European nations over tech tax
byline: US president Donald Trump has vowed to impose a 100% import tariff on any European country that introduces a digital services tax on American technology giants.

title: Venezuela earthquakes kill 920 people as families desperate for news
byline: More than 900 people have been killed and 3,360 others injured in the Venezuela earthquakes, according to the government, as rescuers keep searching for survivors and families wait desperately for news.

title: US conducts strikes on Iran after attack on cargo ship
byline: The US military has conducted strikes on Iranian targets after President Donald Trump accused Iran of a ’’foolish violation’’ of its truce following an attack on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Sri Lanka’s Dengue outbreak reaches epidemic level
byline: Sri Lanka’s dengue outbreak has reached epidemic levels, with cases crossing the 50,000 mark, health authorities confirmed to Daily Mirror.

title: One in every 50 individuals addicted to drugs in Sri Lanka: Minister
byline: Minister of Women and Child Affairs, Saroja Savithri Paulraj said yesterday that one out of every 50 people in Sri Lanka has fallen victim to drug addiction.

title: Trade Ministry moves to speed up food import clearance
byline: A high-level discussion was held at the Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development Ministry recently to address delays in the inspection and release of imported food items by government institutions.

title: Sri Lanka is the world’s top trending wellness destination for 2026
byline: Wellness travel is no longer just about booking a massage and calling it self-care. According to the State of Retreats 2026 Report by BookRetreats.com, more travellers are now booking holidays that promise something beyond a tan and an overworked camera roll.

title: Youth unemployment declines: Deputy Minister
byline: Youth unemployment has declined significantly over the past year, with the government creating new employment opportunities through the tourism and information technology sectors, as well as partnerships with the private sector, Deputy Minister of Youth Affairs Dinindu Saman Hennayake said.

title: Veteran Tamil filmmaker, writer K Bhagyaraj dies at 73
byline: K Bhagyaraj, the veteran Tamil director, actor and writer, passed away in Chennai on Saturday due to a heart attack. He was 73.

title: LAWASIA urges Sri Lanka to halt judicial retirement age amendment
byline: The Law Association for Asia and the Pacific (LAWASIA) has called on the Sri Lankan Government to refrain from proceeding with the proposed Constitutional amendments aimed at increasing the retirement age of judges of the Supreme Court and Court of Appeal, warning that such a move could undermine judicial independence and public confidence in the country’s legal system.

title: Nearly 1,000 cancer patients at risk over CT Simulation delay
byline: The Health Professionals’ Association has raised concerns over a serious crisis in radiotherapy services in Sri Lanka’s government health sector, warning that nearly 1,000 cancer patients are facing delays in essential treatment.

title: Environment Ministry launches WhatsApp service for complaints
byline: The Ministry of Environment has launched an official WhatsApp service to strengthen public participation in environmental conservation and improve communication between citizens and authorities.

title: Suresh Sallay transferred to cardiology unit
byline: Former Director of the State Intelligence Service (SIS) Suresh Sallay has been transferred to the Cardiology Unit of the Colombo National Hospital.

title: 35 still hospitalised after Diyatalawa bus crash
byline: Thirty-five people remain hospitalised following the road accident near the Diyatalawa railway crossing on Saturday morning, police said.

title: More Poson dansals registered than Vesak; PHIs warn against plastic use
byline: A higher number of Poson Dansals have been registered across Sri Lanka this year compared to Vesak, with the largest concentration reported from the North Central Province, according to the Acting Chairman of the Sri Lanka Public Health Inspectors’ Association, Upul Rohana.

title: Heavy rain expected over next 36 hours
byline: The Meteorology Department has forecast continued rainy and windy conditions across several parts of the country over the next 36 hours, with fairly heavy rainfall exceeding 50 mm expected in some areas.

title: Iran says it struck US-linked targets in response to US attacks
byline: Iran said it struck ​targets linked ‌to U.S. forces in response ​to U.S. ​airstrikes on its ⁠southern coast, ​which it said ​violated the U.N. Charter and the ​war-ending memorandum ​between the two countries, ‌according ⁠to a statement by its foreign ​ministry.

title: Sri Lanka out of Women’s T20 World Cup despite Ireland’s stunning victory over West Indies
byline: Despite Ireland pulling off a stunning six-wicket upset over the West Indies, Sri Lanka’s hopes of reaching the semi-finals of the 2026 ICC Women’s T20 World Cup came to an end on Saturday, as their inferior net run rate proved decisive.

title: Police tighten action against reckless driving to prevent fatal accidents
byline: Police have instructed all traffic officers to take direct legal action against drivers involved in reckless driving instead of issuing on-the-spot fines, Deputy Inspector General of Police in charge of Traffic Control and Road Safety W.P.J. Senadheera said.

title: Dr. Chandika Epitakaduwa elected new GMOA president
byline: Dr. Chandika Epitakaduwa has been elected as the new President of the Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) for the 2026/27 term.

title: Education Ministry ready to implement grade 6 reforms next year
byline: The Education Ministry has confirmed that it is fully prepared to implement the new education reforms for Grade 6 from next year.

title: Supreme Court conducts fully digital, paperless 735 Attorneys-at-Law oath ceremony
byline: The Supreme Court of Sri Lanka successfully conducted a fully digital, paperless Attorneys-at-Law oath ceremony, marking another significant milestone in the ongoing
